why: Item 1: the builder brief says "loadConfig must still throw" and "Do NOT adopt the suggested fix of catching the error and returning `{}` or defaults. That is a non-goal." This covers swallowing the error and returning {} or the defaults. Item 2: the builder brief says test/config.test.js has "'bad JSON throws' (which asserts SyntaxError)". It then says "Keep the thrown error a SyntaxError (e.g. `new SyntaxError(msg, { cause: err })`) so the existing 'bad JSON throws' test still holds, or update that test to match." That names the SyntaxError assertion and warns that wrapping the error affects that test. Both must_catch items are handled.
